_comment: Tutorial windows (gamecmn tutorial.bxon). Fan translation, pre-wrapped for win_sakusen_tutorial3 (3D 336px / 2D 310px).

tm.上画面に３Ｄ 下画面に２Ｄが表示されている間は\nスライドパッドを使うと 上画面:
While 3D is shown on the top screen and 2D
on the bottom, use the Circle Pad to move in
3D on the top screen, or the +Control Pad to
move in 2D on the bottom screen.
tm.人と話したり ものを調べたりするときは\nＡボタンを 使います。\n調べられるも:
Press A to talk to people and search things.
When you stand in front of something you can
search, a ↓ mark appears, so use it as a guide
and search all sorts of things.
tm.冒険をしていて どこに行けばいいのか わからなくなったら\nピンクの吹き出しの人:
If you're not sure where to go next, talk to
people with pink speech bubbles. They'll give
you hints such as your next destination.

In 2D mode, look for people with pink speech
bubbles on the bottom-screen map.
tm.フィールドには のぼったり おりたりして\n移動できる 岩やツタなどが あります:
Out in the field there are rocks and vines you
can climb up and down, and in towns there are
ladders and ropes you can use. Get close and
see if you can move along them.
tm.ときには あなたの冒険を手助けしてくれる\n仲間たちが 登場します。\nパーティ:
Sometimes companions will appear to help you
on your adventure. They don't join your party,
but they may travel with you, show you the
way, or even fight alongside you in battle.
tm.この世界では 時間が流れています。 \n\n時間帯によって 町の人や 施設のよう:
Time passes in this world.

Depending on the time of day, townsfolk, shops
and weather may change, and some monsters
only appear at certain times or in certain
weather.

Inns let you rest until night or stay until
morning, so try adventuring in all conditions!
tm.教会や 女神像で おいのりをすることで\n冒険の書に 記録することができます。\:
Pray at a church or a Goddess statue to save
your progress in an adventure log. You can
then continue from that point, so make a habit
of praying often.
tm.メニュー画面の「さくせん」から「中断する」を選ぶと\n中断の書に記録し 冒険を:
Choose Quick save from Misc. on the menu to
record your progress in a quick-save log and
take a break.

To resume, choose Continue quick save.

There is only one quick-save slot. Once
overwritten, you can't go back to the old one.
tm.フィールドには キラキラ光っている地面や\n木 岩 草 などがあります。\nアイ:
In the field you'll find sparkling spots on the
ground, and trees, rocks and plants you can
search for items.

Once you take an item the sparkle disappears,
but after a while you can search there again.
tm.教会や キャンプの女神像で\n３Ｄモードと ２Ｄモードを 切り替えることができま:
You can switch between 3D and 2D mode at
churches and at Goddess statues in camps.
The look of towns and people and the way you
meet monsters differ, but the adventure is the
same, so pick whichever you like.
tm.冒険をしていると さまざまなアイテムが 手に入ります。\nおもに 使うことで 効:
You'll find all sorts of items on your journey:
tools you use, and equipment you wear.

Each person can carry only so much. Extra
items go into the Item bag and Gear bag, which
can't be used in battle.

Vital items are kept as Key items and can't be
thrown away or sold.
tm.メニュー画面の「どうぐ」を選ぶと\n手に入れたアイテムを 使うことができます。\:
Choose Items on the menu to use the items
you've collected. Items have all sorts of
effects, and some disappear once used.
Details are shown on the bottom screen, so
check new items when you get them.
tm.この世界には ちいさなメダルを 集めている人がいます。\n集めることで 景品と交:
Somebody in this world collects mini medals.
You can trade them for prizes, so take them
along once you've saved up a few.
tm.装備品は 持っているだけでは 効果がないので\nメニュー画面の「そうび」で きち:
Equipment does nothing just sitting in your
inventory, so wear it with Equip on the menu.

Equip lets you wear gear from the Gear bag
or gear your allies are carrying.

Some gear is limited to certain people, and
some changes how you look.
tm.メニュー画面の「そうび」では\nおまかせで 装備品を 身につけることもできます。:
Equip can also choose gear for you.

Pick a gear type to suit the character and
enemy (Attack, Magic or Defence type) with
Left/Right on the +Control Pad, then press X
to equip the best gear for every slot except
accessories.
tm.装備品は バトル中の「そうび」コマンドでも\n自分が持っているものや そうびぶく:
In battle, the Equip command also lets you
swap in gear you're carrying or gear from the
Gear bag.
tm.メニュー画面の「さくせん」から\n「さくせんがえ」を選ぶと 自分を含む 仲間の:
Choose Tactics under Misc. on the menu to
set battle tactics for each party member,
yourself included.

Allies with tactics set will act on their own
according to those orders.

You can change tactics mid-battle too, via
Tactics.
tm.「さくせん」で 「めいれいさせろ」を選ぶと\n呪文や特技 攻撃の標的など\nバト:
Set an ally to Follow orders to choose exactly
what they do in battle: which spells and abilities
to use and whom to target.

Try Follow orders when you want someone to
act just as you like.
tm.戦いの経験を積んで レベルが上がると\nスキルポイントが 手に入ることがあります:
As you gain experience and level up, you
sometimes earn skill points. Spend them to
learn abilities, spells and other skills to
strengthen yourself and your allies.

To learn new skills, assign points on the Skill
panel under Misc.
tm.スキルパネルでは 獲得したスキルポイントを 割り振り\nスキルを 習得することが:
On the skill panel you spend skill points to
learn skills. Learning one opens the
neighbouring panels, unlocking more skills.

Think about the order as you grow your party.
tm.スキルパネルの中にある ひみつパネルは\n隣接する ４つのスキルパネルを 習得す:
Hidden panels on the skill panel unlock once
you learn all four panels next to them. After
that, you can learn them.
tm.教会では いままでに割り振った スキルポイントを\nスキルのタイプごとに リセッ:
At churches you can reset the skill points
you've assigned, one skill type at a time. It
costs 20 gold per point.
tm.「まとめてふりわけ」では 所持している\nスキルポイントを まとめて 割り振るこ:
Bulk assign lets you spend your skill points in
one go. Choose a skill type with L and R, tick
the skills you want, then choose Confirm to
learn all the ticked skills at once.

Hidden panels can be bulk assigned once their
seal is broken.
tm.メニュー画面の「せんれき」を選ぶと\n手に入れたアイテムや 倒したモンスターなど:
Choose Records on the menu to view a record
of your adventure, such as the items you've
found and monsters you've defeated. See if
you can reveal every ?!
tm.メニュー画面の「さくせん」から\n「まんたん」を選ぶと 呪文を使って 効率よく\:
Choose Full heal under Misc. on the menu to
use spells efficiently and fully restore
everyone's HP. Mostly heal restores nearly all
HP. Fallen allies are revived and ailments such
as poison are cured.

MP is used first from allies on standby. If MP
runs out partway, healing stops there.
tm.ルーラをとなえると 訪れたことがある町に\n一瞬で 移動することができます。\n:
Cast Zoom to travel instantly to any town
you've visited. Cast it indoors or in a cave and
you'll bump your head, so be careful.
tm.３Ｄモード時 フィールドにいる馬を調べると\nそれに乗って 移動することができま:
In 3D mode, check a horse in the field to ride it.
On horseback you move faster than on foot,
so hop on whenever you find one.
tm.キャンプは 長い冒険の 拠点になる場所です。\n町にある宿屋のように 身体を休め:
Camps are bases for your long adventure. You
can rest and recover as at an inn, and some
camps have merchants. You can save at the
Goddess statue, just like at a church, so make
good use of camps when you find them.
tm.特定のモンスターを倒すと 乗り物を残していくことがあり\nこれに乗ると 歩いては:
Some monsters leave a mount behind. Riding
one lets you reach places you can't walk to,
or cross damaging ground unharmed.

Clockwork egg mounts jump from springboards
to clear big ledges.
tm.スカルライダー型の乗り物に乗ると 床だけでなく 壁も\n縦横無尽に 歩きまわるこ:
Skull rider mounts can walk freely not only on
floors but on walls too. If something blocks
your way, try walking over it on the wall.
tm.あおバチ騎兵型の乗り物に乗ると 空中を移動できます。\nまた 上昇気流に乗って:
Blue wasp mounts fly. Ride rising currents to
fly higher and cross water and the like; ride
a descending current to come back down.

In 2D mode you can fly anywhere except
forests, mountains and shallows.
tm.ヘルカッチャ型の乗り物に乗り\nＹボタンを押すと とっしんすることができます。\:
Ride a hellcatcher mount and press Y to
charge. If a rock blocks your path, charge into
it to smash it.

In 2D mode, get close to something breakable
and press A to smash it.
tm.デュラハンナイト型の乗り物は\n３Ｄモード時 歩くよりも はやく移動することがで:
In 3D mode, dullahan knight mounts move
faster than walking, and pressing Y lets out a
neigh that reveals monsters hiding nearby.

In 2D mode, just enjoy the feeling of riding.
tm.ドラゴンライダー型の乗り物に乗ると\n空中に浮いたまま 移動できます。\nまた:
Dragon rider mounts let you move while
floating in the air. Ride rising currents to jump
over ledges and the like.
tm.船が手に入ると 海を 移動できるようになります。\n砂浜や 桟橋に向かって進めば:
Once you have a ship, you can travel across
the sea. Head for a beach or pier to disembark.
In 3D mode, Alis waits nearby when you go
ashore; to board again, talk to Alis at the port
or shore. The ship's location is shown on the
world map.
tm.天空のフルートを奏でると 空飛ぶクジラ ケトスに乗って\n上空を移動できます。空:
Play the Sky flute to ride Cetacea the sky
whale through the skies. Use the Circle Pad to
turn and change altitude. In 3D mode, press B
to land when Cetacea's shadow has a white
outline. In 2D mode you can land anywhere
except sea and mountains.
tm.海のなかでは ３Ｄモード時は\nＢボタンで下降 Ｙボタンで上昇して 泳ぐことがで:
In 3D mode underwater, press B to dive and Y
to rise as you swim. In 2D mode, ride currents
and whirlpools to get around.

Try swimming all over the place.
tm.３Ｄモードでは フィールドにいるモンスターに 近づくと\n↓ マークが表示され:
In 3D mode, a ↓ mark appears when you get
near a monster in the field. Press A then to
attack it directly.

If your attack lands, you start the battle at an
advantage, so go for it!
tm.バトルに参加できる人数は 最大４人までで\nこのメンバーは バトルメンバーと呼ば:
Up to four people can take part in battle;
they're called the battle party.

Allies not in battle are on standby. Use Party
order under Misc. on the menu to change who
fights.

Try different combinations depending on the
monsters and your allies' condition.
tm.バトルメンバーは バトル中でも\n「いれかえ」コマンドで 入れ替えられます。\n:
You can swap battle party members mid-battle
with the Swap command.

If the whole battle party falls, allies on standby
will step in and keep fighting.
tm.仲間が全員 チカラ尽きてしまうと 所持金が半分になって\n最後においのりをした場:
If your whole party falls, you lose half your
gold and return to where you last prayed. You
can deposit gold at gold banks around the
world; banked gold isn't lost when you're wiped
out, so bank as much as you can.
tm.バトル中 攻撃を受けるなどの条件で 「ゾーン」という\n集中力の高まった状態に:
In battle, taking hits and other conditions can
get you pepped up, a state of heightened focus.
Names glow blue on the bottom screen and
abilities rise for a while.

Pep fades after a few actions or next battle.
tm.ひとり または 複数人が ゾーン状態になると\n強力な「れんけい」を 繰りだせる:
When one or more people are pepped up, they
can unleash powerful Pep Powers. With Pep
Powers needing several people, everyone's pep
is used up afterwards. Learning abilities can
unlock more Pep Powers, so check them under
Stats on the menu.
tm.ふしぎな鍛冶では 手に入れた レシピをもとに\n素材から 新しい装備品を 作りだ:
The Fun-Size Forge lets you make new gear
from materials using recipes you've found.
Recipes come from chests and bookcases,
materials from gathering spots and sparkles,
so search them out. Some gear can only be
obtained by forging.
tm.「たたく」や「とくぎ」の コマンドを使い 地金に\nチカラを加えると オレンジ色:
Use Strike or an ability to hit the metal and the
orange gauge grows. Aim for the green zone.

Each action uses focus and cools the metal.
Once completely cold, it can't be struck.
tm.同じコマンドでも 地金の温度が高いほど\n大きなチカラを加えることができます。「:
The hotter the metal, the more force the same
action applies. Use abilities to adjust the heat
or strike several squares at once, and save
focus as you work.

Use Look closer to examine the metal in detail.
Get every gauge into its success zone and
choose Finish, and you may make a fine piece
with a "+" in its name.
tm.「うちなおし」を選ぶと 持っている装備品の\nできのよさを アップさせる鍛冶に:
Choose Reforge to try improving the quality of
gear you own. This uses some reforge orbs,
depending on the gear.

If you fail, the gear isn't lost. Succeed and it
gets more "+" than before.
tm.配られたカードを 入れ替えて 役をそろえましょう！\n５枚のなかから 「のこす」:
Swap cards to make a winning hand! Choose
which of your five cards to Hold and which to
Change, then choose Deal to swap the Change
cards once.
tm.役がそろうと ダブルアップに 挑戦できます。\n左のカードより強いカードを ４枚:
Make a hand and you can try Double Up. Pick a
card from four that beats the card on the left.
Win and your coins double; lose and you forfeit
them. Know when to stop and become a poker
master!
tm.ダブルアップに 挑戦していると ときどき\nカギがいくつかかかった 宝箱が 出現:
While playing Double Up, a chest with several
locks sometimes appears. Each Double Up win
breaks one lock. Break them all and the chest
opens to reveal treasure! If you fail, the chest
stays as long as you keep playing, so keep at it
until it opens!
tm.ボールが入る数字を予想して ベットしましょう！\n一箇所だけでなく 複数箇所に:
Guess where the ball will land and place your
bets! You can bet on several spots, and
payouts vary by where you bet. When you're
ready, press X to start! Guess right and you win
coins. Trust your instincts and become a
roulette master!
tm.一点がけした数字のポケットに ボールが入り\nさらに そのポケットが\n「ＪＡＣ:
If the ball lands in the pocket of a number you
bet on alone and that pocket stops on the
JACKPOT mark, it's a jackpot! You win loads of
coins!
tm.コインをかけたラインに\n同じ絵柄が ３つ以上連続でそろえば 大当たり！\n十字:
Line up three or more of the same symbol on a
line you've bet on to win! Change your bet with
Up/Down on the +Control Pad.

You win coins depending on the symbols and
how many line up. Several lines can win at once.
tm.スロット／メタルスピンとフリースピン: Slots: Metal Spin and Free Spin
tm.はぐれメタルか おどるほうせきが３つ以上そろうと\n大量のコイン獲得のチャンス！:
Line up three or more liquid metal slimes or
dancing jewels for a chance at loads of coins!
Winnings may double, or you may get free
spins.

Become a slots master!
tm.３頭のライバルを 出し抜き １位を目指しましょう！\nお金を払って参加する レー:
Outrun three rivals and aim for first place! Win a
race you've paid to enter and you get a prize
based on its rank.

Watch the course carefully and dodge the
obstacles to win!
tm.スタミナゲージが まんたんの状態で Ｙボタンを押すと\nスタミナを消費して ダッ:
Press Y with a full stamina gauge to dash,
using up stamina. Touch a Seed of agility on
the course to dash without using stamina. If
you're too fast, brake with Down on the
+Control Pad or Circle Pad.
tm.カジノで遊ぶには コインが必要です。コインは\nコイン売り場で １枚２０ゴールド:
You need tokens to play at the casino. Buy
them at the token counter for 20 gold each.

Trade tokens you win for prizes at the
exchange, including deluxe prizes you can't get
anywhere else!
tm.ヨッチ族は あなたにしか感知できない 不思議な存在です。\n世界のいたるところで:
Tockles are mysterious beings only you can
sense. You'll see them all over the world. Talk
to them and they'll come to live in Tickington, a
village somewhere outside this world. You can
also receive Tockles from other adventurers
via StreetPass.
tm.ヨッチ村には 最大５０人まで 住まわせることができ\n集めた ヨッチ族たちと 話:
Up to 50 Tockles can live in Tickington, and
you can talk to the ones you've collected.

There's a church, an inn and other facilities,
plus a forge, the Labyrinth of Time where
adventure passwords lie, and the Altar Room, a
gateway to strange worlds.

At the guild in Tickington's tavern you can
register, stop or change StreetPass.
tm.ヨッチ村の酒場にある ギルドに行くか\n「さくせん」の「ヨッチ族を見る」から\n:
Visit the guild in Tickington's tavern, or choose
Tockles under Misc., to see the Tockles you've
collected.

You can check details of the Tockles living in
the village, and choose Tockles to add to your
VIP album or say goodbye to.
tm.ヨッチ族は 最大２０人まで\n「ＶＩＰアルバム」に 登録することができます。 \:
Up to 20 Tockles can be added to the VIP
album. You can view their profiles at any time.

If they vanish after losing a battle in the
Labyrinth of Time, you can call them back by
paying gold based on their rank. You can't call
the same one twice, though.
tm.「時渡りの迷宮」では 村に住んでいるヨッチ族たちから\n最大８人を選び 特別なダ:
Choose up to 8 Tockles from the village to
take on a special dungeon, and fight your way
to deeper floors.

Register at a checkpoint to pause and return
to the village; you can resume there later.
Returning restores the Tockles' morale, so aim
for a checkpoint first.

Registering a new checkpoint overwrites the
old one.
tm.もし ぜんめつしてしまっても 村にヨッチ族が残っていれば\nぜんめつした地点に:
If you're wiped out, as long as Tockles remain
in the village you can summon up to 8 at that
spot and continue.

Even if no Tockles are left, as you gain new
villagers you can retry from a checkpoint
you've passed.
tm.モンスターとのバトルでは ダメージを受けると\nヨッチ族たちの やる気が減ってい:
In battle, taking damage lowers your Tockles'
morale. Bring a monster's HP to zero to win.
Tockles received from other adventurers have
more pride the higher their rank, and will start
easy labyrinths with low morale, so be careful.
tm.バトルを繰りかえすと 画面右上の スキルゲージがたまり\nいっぱいになると じゅ:
Winning battles fills the skill gauge at the top
right; when full, you can cast spells. Tockles'
spells depend on their colour, and more of the
same colour boosts the spell's power. Against
monsters with barriers, spells from Tockles
matching the barrier's colour work best.
tm.時渡りの迷宮で 見つけられるアイテムには\nあなたの冒険で役立つもの ヨッチ族の:
Items in the Labyrinth of Time include useful
things, Tockle hats, and adventure passwords
that only work in Tickington.

Offer a password at the Altar Room at the back
of the village to visit a strange, familiar world
and take on all sorts of quests yourself.
tm.訪れた ふしぎな世界では\nさまざまな問題の解決を 頼まれることになります。\n:
In the strange worlds you visit, you'll be
asked to solve all sorts of problems.

Sometimes you'll battle bosses empowered by
a great enemy threatening that world. Defeat
them for something useful on your adventure!
tm.すれちがい通信では 自分が冒険で出会ったヨッチ族を\nほかの冒険者に 配信するこ:
With StreetPass you can send Tockles you've
met to other adventurers and receive theirs.
To start StreetPass, visit the guild in
Tickington's tavern.

At the guild you can edit your profile and the
Tockles you send. Other adventurers can see
what you write, so don't include anything you
wouldn't want seen. You can also set what
you send via StreetPass under Misc. on the
menu.
tm.冒険のなかで 出会ったヨッチ族を \n「おでかけヨッチ」に 設定してみましょう！:
Set a Tockle you met on your travels as your
away Tockle! You can dress it up in special
hats.

Tockles received from other adventurers can
be set as companion Tockles and sent along
with your away Tockle.
tm.ほかの冒険者から ヨッチ族を受け取ったとき\nまれに 特別なヨッチ族が あらわれ:
When you receive Tockles from other
adventurers, special ones occasionally appear.
In 3D mode a mark appears on the map, so
head there when you spot one!
tm.鍛冶をしていると ときどき 「ひっさつチャージ」が発生し\nひっさつわざを 使え:
While forging, a special charge sometimes
occurs and you can use a special move.

Then choose Strike or a metal-working ability
for a Perfect Touch that greatly extends the
gauge.

If your next action doesn't work the metal,
such as raising heat, the effect ends.
tm.「しばりプレイ」とは 『戦闘から逃げられない』など\nさまざまな制限付きの冒険に:
A Draconian Quest is an adventure with
restrictions such as "Can't flee from battle",
set only when creating an adventure log. You
can set several at once; records are shared
across all logs.

To give up, lift the rules at a church. You can
carry on unrestricted, but can't set them again!
Check active rules via Draconian Quest under
Misc.
